description: This file provides a service module for interfacing with the Nominatim API from OpenStreetMap. It includes a function to perform geocode searches by querying the API with a place string, handling HTTP requests, response parsing, and complying with usage policies via dynamic headers.

methods.name: buildPolicyHeaders()
methods.description: Constructs request headers including User-Agent and Referer based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: geocodeSearch(query)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous geocoding request to Nominatim with a query string, processes the response, and returns an array of place objects with latitude and longitude parsed as numbers.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A string representing the place to geocode.

methods.returns: Promise resolving to an array of place objects
